question: Observed Top3 rates by gate, temporal inner/outer reversals accounting for moisture
population: preserved quality extraction, strict normal complete races, exactly ten starters numbered 1 through 10
target: finish_position <= 3; observed association, not a causal effect or time adjustment
primary: Linear probability model with race and horse fixed effects; inner/outer indicators plus year-by-lateral and moisture-band-by-lateral additive interactions; middle reference. Historical exact-distance last-five time features, counts, gaps, event-age, weight, sex nuisance controls reused from preserved design. Nuisance ridge penalty 1; lateral and interactions unpenalized.
standardization: Each distance's full-period moisture race weights applied to every year; each distance's full-period year weights applied to every band. Requires additive year/moisture interactions; not a saturated three-way model.
uncertainty: Date-cluster covariance plus horse-cluster covariance without intersection subtraction, absorbed fixed-effect degrees of freedom, t critical value using smaller cluster count
three_way_check: Separate race+horse FE inner/outer group fits within each fixed era and moisture band, provided >=30 races and >=20 dates. Eras 2017-2020, 2021-2023, 2024-2026partial. Same nuisance controls; not independent validation.
multiplicity: BH separately for overall-distance contrasts, supported standardized annual contrasts, supported standardized band contrasts, supported era-band contrasts, and all supported same-distance year-pair differences; each variant separate family
reversal: Earlier and later standardized annual contrasts have opposite signs and both BH q<0.05, all-pairs change BH q<0.05, and annual signs agree in race-only and no-history sensitivities. Raw sign switches separately descriptive.
nonclaims: No conversion from percentage points to seconds
